entities.name: Jacob van Heeckeren tot Enghuizen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacob Derk Burchard Anne, Baron van Heeckeren tot Enghuizen, also known as Baron van Heeckeren van Beverweerd, was a Dutch diplomat. He received the title baron of the First French Empire in 1813.
